note: Complete (4 passes). Several CDC URLs returned 404 and were replaced or the claim marked unverifiable. No answer options are cut off mid-sentence. Course has no SARS-CoV-2 variant/vaccine policy content beyond ACE2 receptor use.

claims.claim: Crystal violet-iodine complex is retained by thick peptidoglycan of Gram-positives; Gram-negatives lose it with the outer membrane and take up safranin; Mycoplasma lacks a wall and mycobacteria stain unpredictably.
Lipid A is the endotoxin component of LPS, signals via TLR4 and can cause septic shock.
Endospores of Bacillus and Clostridium are dehydrated, dipicolinic acid rich, survive boiling and need steam under pressure to kill.
Griffith's experiment (rough + heat-killed smooth pneumococci) was the classic demonstration of transformation.
Lysogenic conversion encodes diphtheria toxin, botulinum toxin, cholera toxin, Shiga toxin and streptococcal erythrogenic toxins.
claims.note: Source confirms phage-encoded botulinum toxin in certain strains; the C and D type detail was not stated on the page.

claims.claim: Aminoglycosides are ineffective against anaerobes (because uptake is oxygen-dependent).
claims.note: Page confirms ineffectiveness against anaerobes; the oxygen-dependent uptake mechanism was not stated on the opened page.

claims.claim: Diphtheria toxin and Pseudomonas exotoxin A ADP-ribosylate elongation factor 2.
Cholera toxin ADP-ribosylates Gs, locking adenylate cyclase on, raising cAMP and driving chloride and water secretion.
Superantigens (TSST-1, streptococcal pyrogenic exotoxins) bridge MHC II and TCR outside the peptide groove and activate up to a fifth of T cells.
claims.note: Source: up to 20% of T cells.

claims.claim: Terminal complement (C5-C9) deficiency predisposes to Neisseria; asplenia predisposes to encapsulated organisms.
Vaginal flora in reproductive-age women is dominated by Lactobacillus, which maintains a low pH.
claims.note: Source notes lactic acid's primary role in low pH is not fully proven.

claims.claim: Koch postulates and their failure for unculturable organisms, asymptomatic carriers and multi-cause diseases.
S. saprophyticus is novobiocin-resistant and causes UTI in young sexually active women; S. epidermidis is novobiocin-sensitive.
Methicillin resistance arises from mecA encoding PBP2a with low affinity for beta-lactams.
Poststreptococcal glomerulonephritis follows pharyngitis or skin infection with low C3, and penicillin does not reverse it.
claims.note: CDC: insufficient evidence that antibiotics prevent PSGN; treatment helps limit spread.

claims.claim: Streptococcus bovis (gallolyticus) bacteremia is associated with colon neoplasia.
Anthrax toxin: protective antigen delivers edema factor (adenylate cyclase) and lethal factor (protease cleaving MAP kinase kinases).
C. difficile risk factors include clindamycin, cephalosporins and fluoroquinolones; diagnosis by stool toxin or toxin gene testing in symptomatic patients.
claims.note: CDC also lists carbapenems.

claims.claim: Nocardia is aerobic and weakly acid-fast, treated with sulfonamides; Actinomyces is anaerobic, non-acid-fast and treated with penicillin.
Listeria: ampicillin is the usual agent; pregnant, older and immunocompromised patients at risk.
claims.note: CDC: IV ampicillin plus gentamicin; cephalosporin inactivity not stated on the page.

claims.claim: Meningococcal vaccines cover capsular groups A, C, W and Y, and a separate vaccine covers group B.
claims.note: Out of date: pentavalent MenABCWY vaccines (Penbraya, Penmenvy) are now licensed and on the CDC schedule alongside MenACWY and MenB; the lesson implies groups A,C,W,Y and B always need separate vaccines.

claims.claim: E. coli O157:H7 does not ferment sorbitol on sorbitol-MacConkey, and antibiotics may raise HUS risk.
Proteus produces urease, raises urine pH and forms struvite stones.
Legionella urinary antigen detects serogroup 1; macrolides or fluoroquinolones are Legionella-directed therapy.
claims.note: CDC recommends pairing urinary antigen with culture or molecular testing of lower respiratory secretions, since urinary antigen misses other serogroups.

claims.claim: Campylobacter jejuni causes bloody diarrhea from undercooked poultry and is a recognised trigger of Guillain-Barre syndrome.

H. pylori is urease- and oxidase-positive, causes gastritis, ulcers, adenocarcinoma and MALT lymphoma; diagnosed by breath test, stool antigen, biopsy urease; PPI-based regimens guided by local resistance.
Standard first-line agents for active TB are rifampin, isoniazid, pyrazinamide and ethambutol.
claims.note: CDC also lists a 4-month rifapentine-moxifloxacin regimen for eligible patients aged 12+; lesson does not mention it.

claims.claim: Multidrug resistance means resistance to at least isoniazid and rifampin.
IGRAs use antigens absent from BCG and most environmental mycobacteria.
Lyme disease treatment is oral doxycycline in most adults and children above eight years.
claims.note: Out of date: AAP (2018) states courses of 3 weeks or less of doxycycline are safe at all ages, and CDC lists doxycycline for children without an age cutoff; the age-8 restriction should be dropped.

claims.claim: Nontreponemal test (RPR/VDRL) followed by treponemal test, which usually stays positive for life; reverse sequence used; penicillin is the treatment of choice; Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction within hours.
claims.note: CDC: 15-25% treated in primary stage may serorevert on treponemal tests.

claims.claim: Leptospira from animal urine-contaminated water causes fever with conjunctival suffusion and severe disease with renal/liver failure and hemorrhage.
RMSF: treatment with doxycycline should not wait for confirmation; rash begins at wrists and ankles; Dermacentor vector.
claims.note: CDC: doxycycline for all ages including under 8.

claims.claim: Chlamydia trachomatis: doxycycline or azithromycin are used.
claims.note: Imprecise: CDC 2021 recommends doxycycline 7 days as preferred; azithromycin is an alternative (inferior for rectal infection).

claims.claim: Rickettsia rickettsii is most common in the southeastern and south-central United States.
claims.note: Opened CDC statistics page and Wikipedia did not state the regional concentration in text.

claims.claim: Yersinia pestis in the US is maintained in small mammals in the Southwest; plague via flea bites.
claims.note: CDC: northern NM, northern AZ, southern CO, plus CA, southern OR, far western NV.

claims.claim: Brucella acquired from unpasteurised dairy or livestock; occupational hazard; undulant fever; combination therapy to prevent relapse.
Anaplasma phagocytophilum is Ixodes-borne and can co-occur with Lyme disease.
claims.note: CDC treatment duration accounts for concurrent Lyme disease; doxycycline for all ages.

claims.claim: Parvovirus B19 is a ssDNA virus using P antigen, infecting erythroid progenitors: fifth disease, arthropathy, aplastic crisis in sickle cell, hydrops fetalis.
HPV 6/11 cause genital warts, 16/18 cancers; E6 degrades p53, E7 inactivates Rb; vaccines are L1 VLPs.
BK virus causes hemorrhagic cystitis and nephropathy in transplant recipients.
Recombinant zoster vaccine is recommended for older adults.
claims.note: CDC: adults 50+ and immunocompromised adults 19+; lesson could be more specific.

claims.claim: Acyclovir requires viral thymidine kinase activation and terminates DNA chains; TK-deficient resistance is treated with foscarnet.
CMV is a leading congenital infection with hearing loss; owl-eye inclusions; ganciclovir treatment.
RSV prevention in infants includes maternal vaccination and monoclonal antibody products.
claims.note: CDC (Aug 2025): maternal Abrysvo or nirsevimab or clesrovimab; most infants need only one.

claims.claim: Rabies PEP is wound care, immune globulin and vaccine, and works because incubation is long; Negri bodies; bullet-shaped rhabdovirus.
Baloxavir is a polymerase endonuclease inhibitor, a separate class from neuraminidase inhibitors.
HIV diagnosis uses fourth-generation Ag/Ab assays detecting p24, then a differentiation immunoassay and nucleic acid testing.
claims.note: CDC 2014 algorithm, still current.

claims.claim: HCV screening is recommended for adults by current US guidelines.
claims.note: CDC 2020: at least once for all adults 18+ (except prevalence <0.1%) and each pregnancy.

claims.claim: Direct-acting antivirals now cure most hepatitis C patients.
claims.note: About 90% cured with 8-12 weeks.

claims.claim: Mucormycosis in ketoacidosis: broad nonseptate right-angle hyphae; amphotericin plus surgical debridement.
claims.note: Source lists isavuconazole and posaconazole as active alternatives; the lesson's wording 'azoles of the voriconazole type lack activity' is acceptable only if it is clear that posaconazole/isavuconazole are active.

claims.claim: Histoplasma capsulatum: Ohio and Mississippi River valleys, bird and bat droppings.
Echinocandins (caspofungin, micafungin) inhibit beta-glucan synthase.
Hypnozoites of P. vivax and P. ovale need primaquine or tafenoquine, after G6PD testing because of hemolysis risk.
Babesia microti is transmitted by Ixodes ticks and causes hemolysis, particularly in asplenic patients.
claims.note: Maltese cross detail not stated on the page.

claims.claim: Naegleria fowleri enters through the nose in warm freshwater and causes rapidly fatal meningoencephalitis.
claims.note: CDC page returned 404; not checked against an opened page.

claims.claim: Strongyloides hyperinfection occurs with corticosteroids; patients from endemic areas should be treated (ivermectin) before immunosuppression.
Neurocysticercosis follows swallowing T. solium eggs from a carrier, not eating pork cysts.
claims.note: Page did not rank it as a cause of adult-onset seizures.

claims.claim: S. haematobium infects the vesical plexus, causes hematuria and bladder cancer risk; praziquantel is first-line.
claims.note: Lesson's 'praziquantel for most trematodes' omits that Fasciola needs triclabendazole (lesson says 'most', so not wrong).

claims.claim: Autoclaving at 121 C for 15 to 30 minutes, monitored with Geobacillus stearothermophilus spores.
claims.note: CDC minimum for wrapped supplies in gravity sterilizer is 30 min at 121 C; 15 min applies only to some unwrapped loads.

claims.claim: Airborne precautions for TB, measles and varicella; droplet for influenza, meningococcus and pertussis; contact for C. difficile with soap-and-water hand washing.
claims.note: Varicella is airborne plus contact.

claims.claim: vanA and vanB change D-Ala-D-Ala to D-Ala-D-Lac in vancomycin-resistant enterococci.
